**Files:** Create Sources/FlameKit/{GenomeHealth,TemporalFilter,FramePlan}.swift + Tests/FlameKitTests/{FramePlan,GenomeHealth}Tests.swift; delete Sources/EmberweftUI/GenomeHealth.swift + Sources/FlameReference/TemporalFilter.swift; modify FlameReference.swift (re-export), AnimateCommand.swift, CurateCommand.swift.

**Acceptance Criteria:** isRenderable in FlameKit (bounds [1e-3,4000]); TemporalFilter in FlameKit re-exported; FramePlan.descriptor pure + temporal delta scaling correct; animate --frame 5 byte-identical pre/post refactor; parity suite green.

**Verify:** swift test --filter FlameKitTests && make test-parity.

tasks.subject: Task 4: ExportCoordinator (single export) + emberweft export + core DoD
tasks.description:
**Goal:** End-to-end single export — ExportCoordinator actor (FramePlan->renderer->VideoEncoder, off-main, progress+cancel) + emberweft export CLI + disk precheck/atomic-handoff/codec-probe/Metal->CPU fallback. The M6 core DoD.

**Files:** Create Sources/FlameExport/{ExportCoordinator,ExportProgress}.swift + Sources/EmberweftCLI/ExportCommand.swift + Tests/{FlameExportTests/ExportCoordinatorTests, EmberweftCLITests/ExportCommandTests}.swift; modify CLI.swift, Package.swift (EmberweftCLI += FlameExport), main.swift (await). NOTE: export MUST be async — sync export blocking main thread deadlocks await MainActor.run (Metal+temporal has no off-main path).

**Acceptance Criteria:** export <one genome> --segments 1 --out x.mp4 -> playable upright mp4, frame 0 matches animate --frame 0; frame-pixel determinism (two runs byte-identical); overwrite needs --force; atomic handoff on failure; metal falls back to cpu (or --strict-backend exits 1); degenerate genome skipped; genome-count guards exit 2.

**Verify:** swift test --filter FlameExportTests.ExportCoordinatorTests,EmberweftCLITests.ExportCommandTests.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Sources/FlameExport/ExportCoordinator.swift", "Sources/FlameExport/ExportProgress.swift", "Sources/EmberweftCLI/ExportCommand.swift", "Sources/EmberweftCLI/CLI.swift", "Sources/EmberweftApp/main.swift"], "verifyCommand": "swift test --filter FlameExportTests.ExportCoordinatorTests,EmberweftCLITests.ExportCommandTests", "acceptanceCriteria": ["playable upright mp4 matching animate frame", "frame-pixel determinism", "overwrite needs --force", "atomic handoff", "metal fallback", "degenerate skipped", "guards exit 2"], "modelTier": "hard"}
```
